Enjoy HK$300 off upon purchasing HK$4,000 on Klook Hotels and Cruise (Offer is not applicable to products as specified by Klook from time to time) Each user can enjoy offer once during the promotional period and cannot be used in conjunction with other promotions.Offer quotas are on a first-come, first-served basis, while quotas last. The code will not be available once it reaches usage limit. Terms and conditions apply.

vouchers.description: [UnionPay Card] Japan, South Korea, Taiwan & Thailand Hotel HK$100 off
vouchers.tc: Book Selected Japan, South Korea, Taiwan & Thailand Hotel upon HKD 1,000 or above in a Single Net Transaction can enjoy HKD 100 off. Enter the Promo Code at checkout and pay with a UnionPay credit card or debit card. Offer does not apply to activities as specified by Klook from time to time. The promo codes are available on a first-come, first-served basis while the quota lasts. All payment via eWallet or third party payment applications/ platforms are not applicable for the calculation of Eligible Transactions in the Promotion.
